syllabus_topics: Review of the information regarding the diploma project topic
Analysis of output and work conditions
Idea project or methodology of research
Design of necessary equipment and devices
Technical and economic analysis of the developed variants
Development of technical documentation and graphical representation of the results from the research

assessment_methods.method: instructor's assessment of involvement and public/moral qualities
assessor's evaluation of the diploma project
defense in front of the State Exam Committee and public

assessment_rules: The diploma project is evaluated by the instructor based on involvement and public/moral qualities, by an assessor, and by the State Exam Committee during an oral defense. The State Exam Committee evaluates both the project and its defense.
